promptSuffix: Colour grade: deep red, rose, candlelight amber — the palette of Valentine’s Day done with restraint. Warm and intimate, never garish.

translations.love vs. longing: the presence that still feels like absence
translations.given vs. received: the act of giving and the weight of receiving
translations.said vs. unsaid: the words the gesture carried instead
translations.romantic vs. real: the valentine and the person who gave it
translations.expectation vs. presence: the occasion imagined and the evening that actually happened
translations.desire vs. fear: wanting and not knowing what comes after wanting
translations.first vs. last: the first valentine and the one you didn’t know was the last
translations.gesture vs. feeling: the roses and what they stood in for
translations.passion vs. comfort: the fire and what comes after the fire
translations.new vs. familiar love: the first time and the thousandth time
translations.the card vs. the truth: what was written and what was meant
